Definition: from G2596 and G75; to struggle against, i.e. (by implication) to overcome:--subdue.
BiblicalUsage: By faith they subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, and obtained promises.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe faith does not sit still, it subdues what stands against God's promises.
